CELESTIS 17, the "Horizon Flight", is Celestis' 17th memorial spaceflight. Hosted aboard Spaceflight's Sherpa-FX1 satellite, Celestis 17 carries individual flight capsules containing a symbolic portion of cremated remains or DNA from 104 participants.
